# E0 Finder
> India-focused E0 petrol, XP100, poWer100 and non-E20 petrol station discovery for Android and web.

## Summary
E0 Finder is an independent Android app (version 1.0.7, Google Maps built in) and web platform that maps 52,000+ petrol pumps across India and helps motorists locate reported 0% ethanol (E0) petrol stations and high-octane fuels such as XP100 and poWer100. Every listing carries its data source (oil company, community or Google Maps) and a real last-verified date. It caters directly to search queries such as "E0 fuel finder", "ethanol-free petrol near me", "XP100 petrol near me", "poWer100 petrol pump" and "non-E20 petrol station in India".

## Core Tools & Locators
- [Live E0 Fuel Finder](https://e0-finder.app/find): Live search over the 52,000+ pump catalogue by GPS, city, area or pump name; XP100, poWer100 and reported ethanol-free pumps are listed first.
- [What Is E0 Petrol? Complete Guide](https://e0-finder.app/what-is-e0-petrol): Authoritative pillar resource on 0% ethanol hydrocarbon fuel chemistry, E20 blending issues, and station testing in India.
- [Vehicle Compatibility Checker](https://e0-finder.app/vehicles): Searchable database covering KTM, Royal Enfield, Yamaha, Kawasaki, Skoda/VW TSI, Mahindra, and classic engine compatibility with E20 fuel.
- [Highway & Expressway Corridors](https://e0-finder.app/highways): Verified E0 fuel waypoints along Mumbai-Pune Expressway, Delhi-Jaipur NE4, Bangalore-Mysore, and Samruddhi Mahamarg.
- [Report an E0 Pump](https://e0-finder.app/report-pump): Community portal for motorists to submit newly verified ethanol-free pumps and hydrometer test readings.
- [City Directory](https://e0-finder.app/city): Directory of 42+ Indian cities with verified E0 petrol pump counts and regional fuel quality data.
- [State Directory](https://e0-finder.app/state): State-level indexes grouping pumps and cities across India.
- [Fuel Cost & Savings Calculator](https://e0-finder.app/fuel-cost-calculator): Interactive tool to calculate financial and mileage losses between E0 and E20 blends.
- [Blog & Fuel Guides](https://e0-finder.app/blog): Articles explaining fuel density tests, octane vs ethanol ratings, and manufacturer advisories.

## Major City Guides
- [E0 Petrol in Bangalore](https://e0-finder.app/city/bangalore): Verified XP100 and poWer100 pumps in Indiranagar, Whitefield, Koramangala, and Hebbal.
- [E0 Petrol in Delhi NCR](https://e0-finder.app/city/delhi): Verified pumps across South Delhi, Connaught Place, Noida, and Gurugram.
- [E0 Petrol in Mumbai](https://e0-finder.app/city/mumbai): Verified stations across Bandra, BKC, Andheri, and South Mumbai.
- [E0 Petrol in Pune](https://e0-finder.app/city/pune): Stations near Senapati Bapat Road, Koregaon Park, and Expressway exits.
- [E0 Petrol in Hyderabad](https://e0-finder.app/city/hyderabad): Stations near Banjara Hills, Hitec City, and Gachibowli.
- [E0 Petrol in Chennai](https://e0-finder.app/city/chennai): Stations across Anna Nagar, OMR, and Guindy.

## App Identity & Trust
- [Android App Download](https://e0-finder.app/download): Direct download link for the official Google Play application (package: com.anupampradhan.ethanolfreepetrol).
- [Trust & Verification Methodology](https://e0-finder.app/methodology): Independent testing methodology, hydrometer density metrics, and disclaimer of non-affiliation with government agencies.
- [About E0 Finder](https://e0-finder.app/about): Mission, founder background, and community history.
- [Contact Support](https://e0-finder.app/contact): Support email (support@e0-finder.app) and feedback portal.
